text_block_list.text:
Through three years of running the Twinkle 
Series with Buena Vista, she became the 
"Heroine of an Era."

However, the era moves on relentlessly. 
—And the center of expectations changes 
along with it.

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the midday news. Our first 
topic is... this!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Appearing at last on Noon Talks! The king 
of the racing world, Orfevre! Will 
bombshell statements be dropped!?"

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Given the chance for an exclusive with 
Orfevre, the Umamusume currently capturing 
the public's eye, we eagerly set out, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "—I grow weary of this. Begone."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Ehh~!? B-But we just got here...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"There is but one decree for the people. 
—Prepare for the 'Pinnacle Dream.'"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, did you watch the latest "Daytime 
Talks"? That thing Lord Orfevre said... It 
means what I think it means, right?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously so freakin' cool! As expected of 
"The 1st," holding the consecutive #1 
streak! Orfe's totally gonna pull it off 
this time...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you catch that last race? 
Gentildonna might just be, like, insanely 
strong—"

Buena Vista might no longer carry the 
heaviest burden of expectations. 
However—some things never change.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaaaaa!! Go for iiiiiit!!

“—The trust that was built up. The 
expectations of the fans... and their 
love.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —...Haaaaaaah!!

"Something that never changes. Buena 
Vista, always giving it her all. Seeing 
that... I—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wah... the way she runs... I kind 
of...—like it.

Another layer of trust is built. That 
trajectory will surely transcend the eras. 
And so—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...I won! Peace peace♪"

"—That I am always by her side. That, 
too... will never change."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Is everyone ready? Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeeers!

Today, an appreciation event for all 
racing fans was held to express gratitude 
for all their support so far.
choice_data_list: We have refills right over here!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
We can handle it ourselves, so don't 
worry! Trainer, please go ahead and join 
the toast too!

text_block_list.name: One of the Fans
text_block_list.text:
This is a party to celebrate your hard 
work, too! After all, you and Buena-chan 
have been working hand in hand all this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If you say so, we need to add way, waaay 
more legs!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Me, Trainer, and everyone who supports us.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to so many people, I was able to 
make it this far—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, with the support of so many 
people..."

text_block_list.name: One of the Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Buena-chan... Man, we're such suckers 
for those tears...!

"The fans tearing up alongside me. While 
deeply touched by that heartwarming sight, 
something still tugs at the back of my 
mind..."
choice_data_list:
(...Those don't look like her usual 
tears?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whoa... What a nice view...

As the banquet reached its peak, I took 
Buena Vista outside under the guise of a 
break.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
This is a magnificent view too, isn't it? 
Truly... there are so many beautiful 
things in this world...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kinds of scenery I'll see 
from here on... How far these legs can 
carry me... I'm looking forward to finding 
out.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer? What's up?

"What kind of emotion did that come from?" 
... Knowing full well it was uncouth, I 
asked. I just couldn't help but wonder 
about the reason behind those tears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Ah... I can tell you were happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I'm okay. ...I was just 
surprised that you could tell that, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...To tell you the truth, I don't really 
understand it myself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My heart was filled to the brim with 
gratitude for so many different people...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And then, strangely enough... a different 
kind of gratitude welled up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It might sound strange, but... I felt like 
saying thank you to myself, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And then, tears just suddenly spilled 
over... I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's weird, isn't it...
choice_data_list: ...Then, can I give you my thanks too?
...Then, can I give you my thanks too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah!

Aiming straight for that "something" deep 
within her heart... I pour my soul into 
conveying it to her.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for showing me so many 
breathtaking sights.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Let's continue to see many more wonderful 
sights... together, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Promise!

I nodded, murmuring to myself in my heart: 
The greatest scenery is always right in 
front of me—

From here on, together with Buena Vista... 
With the same eyes, with the same heart... 
we will see the same breathtaking view.
